race.comment: THE COSMIC ONE (9) tackles open class for the first time but has fitness on some of the better performed galloper and is hard to fault. Has won three of four this campaign and drops 4.5kg on the latest win. Looks tough to beat. CASH (4) was tested in stakes class last time in and finished the campaign with a second over 1529m in the City Of Adelaide Stakes. Has a good record fresh though and did win only try course and distance. SNOOPY NOW (3) is back in trip off a few weeks break and will be winding up late. STARLITE VALLEY (6) is a veteran who rates highly on best form and is among the main chances.
